description: Residual detector settings (cards M3-02..M3-04). Thresholds themselves are fitted per tail on nominal frames; these are the design constants.

cusum_k_sigma.ref: CUSUM allowance in residual sigmas: tuned for the fastest detection of a sustained 1-sigma shift (Montgomery, Introduction to Statistical Quality Control, ch. 9: k = delta/2)

persistence_k.ref: confirm when k of the last n raw alarms fired; at 1 frame/s this is the idea text's ~3 s persistence

fdi.description: Sensor validation / fault detection and isolation (card M3-03). Physical sensor ranges and rates per sensor kind; noise sigma comes from the sensor model in configs/physics sensors (the datasheet noise of the sender).

range.ref: sensor measuring range: a reading outside it is impossible for the sender (S06), not an engine state

max_rate_per_s.ref: fastest physical change per second; a faster jump is a sensor artefact (open thermocouple, ADC glitch)

freeze_window.ref: frames without variation before a channel counts as stuck (S01)

freeze_var_fraction.ref: stuck when the window variance is below this share of the sender's noise variance

noise_window.ref: frames used for the excess-noise check (S04)

noise_var_factor.ref: noisy when the robust (median second-difference) noise estimate exceeds 7 x the sender's sigma; 5 x gave ~1 stray quarantine per 15 min on nominal flights

lane_sigma.ref: lane A/B disagreement threshold in sender sigmas (S07)

recover_frames.ref: clean frames before an automatically quarantined channel is trusted again

autoencoder.description: Reconstruction-error novelty scorer with an EVT threshold (card M3-04, idea text I-03/I-04).

hidden_units.ref: hidden layer width of the autoencoder

bottleneck_units.ref: bottleneck width: narrower than the 13 residual features, so only normal structure reconstructs

evt_tail_quantile.ref: peaks-over-threshold level u for the Generalized Pareto fit of nominal scores

evt_alpha.ref: per-frame false-alarm target of the novelty channel; the GPD tail extrapolates it from fewer than 1/alpha held-out frames

random_state.ref: fixed seed: the scorer is deterministic
